stem: Why is the Battle of Saratoga considered a turning point in the Revolutionary War?

options.label: F
options.text: The British victory extended the fighting for another year.

options.label: G
options.text: The American defeat led many soldiers to desert the Continental army.

options.label: H
options.text: The British defeat marked the beginning of a steady decline in British military superiority.

options.label: J
options.text: The American victory convinced France to ally with the United States.
